dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: If the children come today as well, I suppose I'll give them these here toys...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And these here are...

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oh, hello there. These are some abandoned machines that my daughter Alida picked up. She likes to do that, bringing back all kinds of odds and ends from her outdoor play sessions.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Some of them even move with a wee fix-em-up. Since the kids nearby are fond of 'em, I don't see the harm in giving them out. Alida's friends are especially big fans...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you a craftsman of a sort, then?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Haha, I don't suppose I count. Just a barely-competent grease monkey, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Before coming here, I worked in the Fontaine Research Institute, and so I've rented this shop with Miss Cairuo. I just help people fix some simple mechanisms, and enjoy the company of my daughter. We get by.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: If the problem's too complicated, or if some core parts are busted up, then our clients will have to find help somewhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: See you. Keep your eyes and ears open.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any special mechanisms?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Special mechanisms? Hahaha, that's a good one. Does it look like I'm in the business of making fancy contraptions?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Sure, I might once have worked at the Fontaine Research Institute, but that was a lifetime ago. Now it's all I can do to mend these little trinkets and make a few toys for the children.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Have you visited the Institute, by the by? The Fonta they make is the bomb, but it always seems to sell out right after lunchtime...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fonta? It's usually on sale around the clock...

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oho, yes, yes, my memory must be playing up — how could Fonta ever sell out?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Anyway, if there's nothing else, I've got some toys to make. Feel free to take a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Might you have any special gadgets in stock?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: A special mechanism, you say? Well, that depends on what you need, Lady Nefer. O{RUBY#[D]Marechaussee Phantom}ur shop has plenty of fine goods to choose from — it all depends on what you're willing to offer.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: It's about Jahoda's a{RUBY#[D]The Seahook Gang}rm. I've heard that some of the s{RUBY#[D]remaining members}pare parts have b{RUBY#[D]made their way to Fontaine}ecome available in Fontaine, so I came to ask if you might know anything about it.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: That might take some time to track down. If the spare parts happen to fall into the r{RUBY#[S]Fleuve Cendre}iver, at least we have some re{RUBY#[S]Spina di Rosula}liable friends who could help retrieve them. But if they're scattered just anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Then I'll be counting on you, Mr. Lestocq. Come to think of it, I just had someone purchase some F{RUBY#[D]intel}onta the other day. I'll send you a few later as thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Much obliged, Lady Nefer. If we do manage to find the parts, I'll have them delivered to you straight away, rest assured.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way — when Miss Jahoda was last here, she seemed rather interested in this toy. Now, I might've just imagined it... but would you mind bringing it to her as well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Might you have any special gadgets in stock?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oh, are you interested in gadgets too, Miss Jahoda? Hehe, I'm not going to try and fix your arm. At least, not here...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Tch, I don't need you to fix my arm. I'm just here to ask some questions on Boss Nef's behalf. The Fon{RUBY#[D]intel}tas you ordered from us have arrived. May I assume that you have your pay{RUBY#[D]intel for exchange}ment ready?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oh, the shipment's here? That's fast. The Curatorium of Secrets is certainly reliable as always. The payment has of course been prepared long ago — falling behind has never been ou{RUBY#[D]Marechaussee Phantom}r habit.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: However, please kindly let Lady Nefer know she must come collect it at her earliest convenience. If the ice used for cooling melts, the Fontas may lose their fla{RUBY#[D]timeliness}vor.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Tch, don't worry, they will be delivered on time. Just don't forget the payment, Mr. Lestocq. I'll go report back now.
